name: Arista 7060XE7-64PS 102.4 Tb/s switch (spine)
description: 4RU air-cooled Broadcom Tomahawk 6 class switch (per press), 64 x 1.6T OSFP, 102.4 Tb/s, 267 MB buffer. Modeled here as 128 x 800G (2 x 800G per 1.6T cage, the datasheet's max 800G port count). Arista lists Q4 2026 availability; power and weight not yet published.

ports.note: max 800G ports (64 x 1.6T OSFP cages, 2 x 800G each)

port_speed_gbps.note: native 1600G per cage; 800G per logical port here

power_w.note: typical with DACs, not published. Scaled from Arista 7060X6-64PE (640 W typical at 51.2 Tb/s) for 2x bandwidth on a newer process node

power_max_w.note: max with optics, not published. 7060X6-64PE max 2218 W at 51.2 Tb/s doubled, plus higher-power 1.6T optics

weight_kg.note: not published; typical of 4RU 64 x 1.6T air-cooled switches (Celestica DS6001 2OU liquid is 30 kg)

sources.title: Arista press release: Next-Generation 1.6Terabit Portfolio for AI Fabrics (2026-06-09)
heise: Arista 7060XE7 1.6 Tbit/s switches for AI networks
